{Our new algorithm calculates priority as the maximum number of the given item that can fit entirely into each bin (the floor of bin capacity divided by item size), assigning negative infinity to any bin that cannot hold even one instance of the item, so higher priority scores correspond to bins that enable more total items to be stored.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    fit_counts = np.floor(bins / item)
    return np.where(bins >= item, fit_counts, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:

    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.

    """

algorithm: {This best-fit priority algorithm assigns a priority score equal to the negative of the remaining bin space after placing the item in each bin (with negative infinity priority for bins that cannot accommodate the item), such that bins where the item leaves the smallest remaining space receive the highest priority.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    priorities[valid_mask] = item - bins[valid_mask]
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
